metadata.creator: DJ Chuck Chillout
metadata.description:
Great Chuck Chillout episode from the spring of 1988 with plenty of classics alongside long-forgotten tracks ("Hot Pants," "My Rhythm is Kept"). Likewise, there are lots of great drops from legends and forgotten crews alike. Definitely a reminder how dope and genre-changing 1988 was.

It's Chuck Chillout and he's live... understaaaaaand?

01
  • Intro
  • Chuck Chillout theme (?)... Deuces Wild
  • Top Billin (Teddy Ted Mix) (No Half Steppin)... Audio Two
  • Fly Girl... Grandmaster Flash & The Furious Five
  • Plug Tunin' (Last Chance To Comprehend)... De La Soul
  • Rock Box... Run-DMC
  • Paid in Full (Instrumental)... Eric B. & Rakim
  • Airbreak

02
  • Airbreak (cont.?)
  • Run's House... Run-DMC
  • Here We Go Again... DJ Jazzy Jeff & The Fresh Prince
  • Da Butt... EU
  • Rebel Without a Pause... Public Enemy
  • ?
  • Airbreak

03
  • Strong Island... JVC Force
  • Because I Got It Like That (Dub)... Jungle Brothers
  • My Mic is On Fire... Lord Shafiyq
  • (cut?)
  • Shelton-D Is Outstanding... Shelton-D
  • Airbreak

04
  • It's My Thing (Dub)... EPMD
  • Hickeys Around My Neck... Audio Two
  • Hot Pants... Wit Nice (The Rap Warlock)
  • Move the Crowd... Eric B. & Rakim
  • Brand New Funk... DJ Jazzy Jeff & The Fresh Prince
  • Airbreak

05
  • Can You Feel It... Original Concept
  • Small Time Hustler... The Dismasters
  • My Rhythm Is Kept... Kay D. & D.J. Stash
  • Beats to the Rhyme... Run-DMC
  • It Takes Two... Rob Base & DJ E-Z Rock

06
  • Raw... Big Daddy Kane
  • DBC Let the Music Play... Stetsasonic
  • You Gots to Chill... EPMD
  • The Music Ain't Loud E-Nuf... DJ Kool
  • Super Casanova... Super Lover Cee & Casanova Rud
  • Once More You Hear the Dope Stuff... Three Times Dope
  • Get Pepped... Skinny Boys
